|arg= global

|gr1= Triggers

|descr= Returns trigger activation. 

{{Feature | important | The trigger could be [[Multiplayer Scripting#Locality|local]] or remote but the result returned by this command will be for the trigger activation set up locally on the client that executed the command. See [[createTrigger]] for more info.}}

|s1= [[triggerActivation]] trigger

|p1= trigger: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [by, type, repeating, persistent]
* by: [[String]] - See [[setTriggerActivation]]
* type: [[String]] - See [[setTriggerActivation]]
* repeating: [[Boolean]] - See [[setTriggerActivation]]
* persistent: [[Boolean]] {{GVI|arma3|2.24}} - See [[setTriggerActivation]]

|x1= <sqf>_activation = triggerActivation someTrigger;</sqf>

|seealso= [[setTriggerActivation]] [[triggerActivated]] [[triggerInterval]] [[setTriggerInterval]] [[enableSimulation]] [[simulationEnabled]]
}}
